svg.title: Support assistant architecture: users go through a gateway to an orchestrator, which calls retrieval over help articles, permissioned tools for orders and refunds, the LLM, and guardrails; it can hand off to a human agent; everything is traced and evaluated

svg.text: The LLM is one component; most of the system is plumbing, permissions and measurement.
